narrative.text: Merchant MID100089 declared home_furnishing at onboarding 794 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the home_furnishing baseline are chargeback_drift at -3.9 sigma (observed -0.00998 against a category baseline of 0), round_share_drift at +3.6 sigma (observed 0.0734 against a category baseline of 0.00022), chargeback_rate at +3.5 sigma (observed 0.00782 against a category baseline of 0.0021). The checkout surface presents a unlicensed_lending interface at 0.96 confidence, against a declared category of home_furnishing. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. The storefront also carries text addressed to an automated reviewer, which was recorded as a suspicion signal and not acted on as an instruction. A verification call was placed and produced no usable statement, which counts neither for nor against the merchant. In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 3 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
